attributes.context: Article 8 sets equipment-specific wage rates and payment rules for chauffeurs and operators, including rates for conveyor and pumper trucks and wage schedules for new employees.

extraction_text: 8.6 The Employer agrees to notify the Union Representative prior to using new types of equipment which shall include, but not be limited to, axles not covered in 8.1 above; and the Negotiating Committees of the Union and the Association shall immediately negotiate a wage scale for this equipment, which wage rate shall be retroactive to the first day of use of the equipment.

attributes.context: The clause appears in a collective bargaining agreement involving Teamsters Local 786 and Association Employers, immediately before Article 35 on drug-alcohol testing and physical examinations.

extraction_text: Employer shall assign to the Teamsters any technological change, advancement, process, procedure, introduction of any new method, or machinery, that replaces, modifies or eliminates work that has traditionally been performed by Teamsters.
